q: 1. Public works must be of very good quality, because
options: it is paid in higher rate
users are general public and maintenance is not timely difficulty and costly
explain: But as per book b. Public works serve the general public continuously; poor quality causes costly, delayed maintenance affecting many users, so high quality is essential.

q: 2. The construction of airports is treated as
explain: Airports involve large-scale earthwork, runways, and infrastructure comparable to dams/highways, classifying them as heavy construction.

q: 3. Which of the following is not an excavating equipment?
explain: Per the answer key, scraper is the odd one out (it is mainly a hauling/spreading machine); shovel, dragline and hoe are excavators.

q: 4. For excavating solid rocks, the most suitable equipment is
explain: The answer key gives hoe (d). Note: many textbooks name the power shovel for blasted rock.

q: 5. Policy is
options: a rule or a set of rules never to be violated
a definite rule along which one has to proceed
a procedure for preparing the project report
a set of broad guidelines stipulated by management
explain: Policies serve as overarching guidelines established by executive management to direct decision-making and organizational actions.

q: 6. The conception of idea for any construction work is the responsibility of
explain: The owner identifies the need and originates the idea for a construction project; engineers and contractors act on it afterward.

q: 7. The size of a power shovel is indicated by the size of
explain: A power shovel is rated by its dipper (bucket) capacity in cubic metres or cubic yards.

q: 8. Which one of the following does not form a part of Derrick crane?
explain: A derrick crane consists of a mast, boom and guy ropes; a jack is not part of it.

q: 9. Which one of the following does not fall under the category hoisting equipment?
explain: A dragline is an excavator, not hoisting equipment. Per the key, d is correct.

q: 10. Tractive coefficient of a Crawler truck in loose soil is
options: less than that of rubber tyre tractors
more than it at of rubber tyre tractors
same as that of rubber tyre tractors
explain: Tracks grip loose soil better than rubber tyres, so the tractive coefficient is higher.

q: 11. A project is
options: a large dam constructed across a river for a single or multi-purpose
any job involving many people and large money
a work of major importance involving huge men and material
an organized team work to achieve a set task within the time limit
explain: A project is generally defined as an organized, coordinated effort of a team to accomplish a specific objective within a defined time frame.

q: 12. Policy is
options: a rule or a set of rules never to be violated
a definite route along which one has to proceed
a procedure for preparing the project report
a set of broad guidelines stipulated by management
explain: Policy refers to broad guidelines set by management to direct decision-making, distinct from rigid rules or fixed procedures.

q: 13. In a line organization
options: responsibility of each individual is fixed
explain: Line organization has strong discipline, quick decisions and fixed responsibility.

q: 14. In a functional organization
options: specialised knowledge and guidance to individual worker is provided
explain: Specialisation gives better quality, less wastage and expert guidance.

q: 15. The salient feature of the organization evolved by F.W. Taylor is
options: separation of planning and design part for field work
explain: Taylor's functional organization separates planning from execution and relies on functional efficiency and strict specifications.

q: 16. The major principle of an organization is
explain: Span of management, unity of command and delegation of authority are all basic principles.

q: 17. The process of removal and loading of broken rock pieces from a tunnel is known as
explain: Mucking is the removal and loading of blasted rock (muck) in tunnelling.

q: 18. Work study comprises
explain: Work study = method study + work measurement.

q: 19. The first stage of a construction, is
explain: Construction begins with the initiation of the proposal/idea, before surveys, estimates, or fund allotment occur.

q: 20. The main function of the construction management is
explain: Construction management encompasses all managerial functions - planning, organizing, and directing - to achieve project objectives.

q: 21. Construction team means
explain: A construction team comprises the owner, engineer/architect, and contractor working together to complete the project.

q: 22. Military organisation is known as
explain: Military organizations follow a strict chain-of-command structure characteristic of line organization.

q: 23. The main advantage of line organization, is
explain: Line organization provides clear command, defined responsibilities, and strong discipline - all being its key advantages.

q: 24. Frederick W. Taylor introduced a system of working know as
explain: F.W. Taylor introduced functional organization, dividing management functions among specialists.

q: 25. The most popular type of organization used for civil engineering constructions is
explain: Line and staff organization combines direct command with specialist advisory support, making it most suitable and popular for civil engineering construction.

q: 26. PERT is an abbreviation for
options: pertinent equation related to a task
explain: PERT = Programme (Program) Evaluation and Review Technique.

q: 27. Expected project duration generally follows
explain: Per the answer key, a. The project duration is a sum of many activity times, so by the central limit theorem it is taken as normal. Activity times follow the beta curve.

q: 28. The area under the β-distribution curve is divided into two equal parts by
explain: The expected time divides the area into two equal halves, so there is a 50% chance on either side.

q: 29. Which one of the following surface will give highest coefficient of traction while using crawler track tractors?
explain: Per the answer key, earth, where the track grousers can grip.

q: 30. Which of the following surfaces will give highest rolling resistance for a rubber tyred vehicle?
explain: Tyres sink into loose sand, giving the highest rolling resistance.

q: 31. Functional organization system of working was introduced by
explain: F. W. Taylor introduced functional organization.

q: 32. Residential buildings are treated as
explain: Residential buildings, being relatively small-scale structures, are classified as light construction.

q: 33. Power stations are generally treated as
explain: Power stations, involving heavy machinery and large-scale industrial processes, are classified under industrial construction.

q: 34. The process of inspiring the subordinates to do work or achieve an objective is called as
explain: Inspiring people to achieve an objective is motivation.

q: 35. The main function of the construction management is
explain: Management covers planning, organising, directing and controlling.

q: 36. The construction works costing below rupees twenty thousand are classified as
explain: Low-cost works are classed as minor works.

q: 37. The construction costing above rupees one lac are classified as
explain: Per the answer key, projects.

q: 38. The process of inspiring the subordinates to do a work or achieve an objective is called as
explain: Motivation is the specific management function of inspiring subordinates towards achieving objectives.

q: 39. The construction of residential building are treated as
explain: Residential buildings are light construction.

q: 40. The construction of ……… belongs to industrial construction.
explain: Chemical plants are industrial construction.

q: 41. The construction of airport are treated as
explain: Airports are heavy construction.

q: 42. Military type of organization is known as
explain: Line organization follows a military-style chain of command.

q: 43. Which of the following is NOT among the principles a project manager must follow in terms of professional responsibility and ethical principles?
options: interacting with the project team in a professional and cooperative manner
explain: Blindly fulfilling a contractor's demands is not an ethical professional responsibility; the manager must act impartially, not favor one party's demands.

q: 44. For which of the following materials, the output of power shovels for a fixed shovel size will be maximum
explain: Per the answer key, moist loam, which digs easily and fills the dipper well.

q: 45. Which of the following excavators is most suitable for digging under water?
explain: Per the answer key, dragline. Note: many books give clamshell.

q: 46. Clamshell are used to remove loose material from inside
explain: Clamshells dig deep, narrow holes such as cofferdams, pier foundations and manholes.

q: 47. Which of the following is not another name of Hoe?
explain: A trenching machine is a different machine. Backhoe, back-shovel and pull shovel are names for the hoe.

q: 48. Hoe is primarily used to excavate
options: below the natural surface of the ground on which the machine rests
trenches requiring precise control of depth
pits of basements requiring precise control of depth
explain: A hoe digs below its own level, including trenches and basement pits.

q: 49. The main purpose of planned maintenance of roads is:
options: to keep road surface in a good condition
to reduce the vehicle operation costs
to reduce the total transportation costs
explain: Planned road maintenance primarily aims to reduce vehicle operation costs by keeping roads in a condition that minimizes wear and fuel consumption for users.

q: 50. The major principal of an organization is
explain: Span of management, unity of command, and delegation of authority are all fundamental principles of organizational structure.
